description.text: Scholarship Policy According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY32,000/Year instead of CNY 44,000 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Faculty&Staff Theschoolnowhas150teachingstaffs,including24professors,34associateprofessors,16seniorexperimentersandengineers,and70doctors.Thefull-timeundergraduateandthepostgraduatestudentsaremorethan3000and100,respectively.

duration.text: The Inorganic Chemistry at University of Jinan is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6111 USD/per year ￥ 44000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1.The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries. 2.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3.Applicants must be in good health
